screening_decisions.reason: Adults with frozen shoulder randomized to mobilisations, steroid, ice, or no treatment; manual therapy/exercise present; outcomes include pain and ROM.
Observational incidence/management study in general practice; not an RCT/quasi-RCT of manual therapy or exercise specifically for adhesive capsulitis.
Educational review on joint mobilization principles; not a randomized or quasi-randomized trial.
Open RCT in frozen shoulder comparing physical therapy alone vs. PT plus arthrography with IA steroid; includes therapeutic exercises; outcomes VAS and goniometric ROM.
Methodological review on RCT reporting; not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized controlled trial in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis using deep transverse friction massage and capsular stretching (manual therapy).
Adults with frozen shoulder randomized to two supervised exercise programs; outcomes include VAS, ROM, and function.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial comparing mobilization techniques (ERM/MRM/MWM) for frozen shoulder; manual therapy focus.
Comparative study in chronic peri-arthritis/frozen shoulder assessing PNF vs conventional exercises to improve ROM; appears to involve exercise-based interventions.
Randomized pilot comparing AP vs PA glide mobilizations in adhesive capsulitis; outcomes include ER ROM and pain.
Population prevalence/impact study; not an RCT/quasi-RCT and not an intervention trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Multiple-subject case report; not randomized/quasi-randomized.
Placebo-controlled RCT in adhesive capsulitis testing IA corticosteroid ± supervised physiotherapy vs saline ± physiotherapy; home exercise across groups; SPADI and ROM outcomes.
Blinded RCT post-distension assigning to manual therapy + directed exercise vs sham ultrasound; outcomes include pain, function, active abduction, QoL, and perceived success.
Questionnaire responsiveness evaluation in observational framework; not an RCT/quasi-RCT.
Non-randomized comparative study of acupuncture and physical therapy; design not RCT/quasi-RCT.
Systematic review/cost-effectiveness analysis; not a primary RCT/quasi-RCT.
Concept/protocol-like abstract without clear randomized comparative data; not a completed RCT/quasi-RCT.
Methodological study on outcome reporting bias; not a clinical RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Abstract content unrelated to adhesive capsulitis (multiple sclerosis cohort); not relevant.
Randomized clinical trial in frozen shoulder comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination therapy; SPADI and ROM outcomes.
Adults with adhesive capsulitis randomized to Cyriax deep friction massage + mobilization vs daily PT; both with stretching/home exercise; primary endpoint ROM; pain assessed.
Prospective natural history study; no randomized comparison of manual therapy/exercise.
Statistical methods paper on heterogeneity; not a clinical trial.
Methods chapter on reporting biases; not a clinical trial.
Prospective observational natural history; not an RCT/quasi-RCT.
Randomized comparison of mobilization + active exercises vs exercises alone in painfully restricted shoulders (likely adhesive capsulitis); outcomes pain and isolated GH mobility.
RCT comparing hyaluronate, steroid, and physical therapy modalities, but PT arm not clearly manual therapy or exercise; intervention outside manual/exercise focus per abstract.
EMG study of shoulder muscles during exercises; not a randomized clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative study in chronic shoulder pain (mixed etiologies), not specific RCT in adhesive capsulitis with manual/exercise.
Randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing local corticosteroid injection vs physical therapy measures; pain (VAS) and ROM outcomes.
Methods chapter; not a clinical RCT.
Retrospective study; not randomized/quasi-randomized.
Randomized controlled study comparing Mulligan’s vs Maitland’s mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis.
Methods chapter; not a clinical RCT.
Population consultation patterns; not an RCT/quasi-RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
RCT in shoulder periarthritis using iontophoresis/phonophoresis (electrotherapy), not manual therapy or exercise interventions per selection criteria.
Observer-blind randomized trial in painful stiff shoulder/periarthritis (commonly including adhesive capsulitis) comparing steroid injection, physiotherapy, or both.
Double-blind RCT in frozen shoulder where exercise is combined with electroacupuncture or interferential therapy vs no treatment; exercise constitutes a core intervention.
Randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing ibuprofen alone vs ibuprofen + physical therapy; outcomes include SPADI and global rating.
Randomized controlled trial adding end-range mobilization techniques to exercises/ultrasound vs exercises/ultrasound alone in chronic adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing anterior vs posterior glide joint mobilization; primary outcome external rotation ROM; pain decreased in both.
Randomized placebo-controlled trial in adhesive capsulitis: IA triamcinolone and/or standardized physiotherapy; home exercise provided; disability, pain, and ROM outcomes.
Prospective randomized study in adhesive capsulitis comparing manipulation under anesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy.
Systematic review; not a primary RCT/quasi-RCT.
Methods chapter on meta-analysis; not a clinical RCT.
Prospective management study stratified by factors; not randomized/quasi-randomized between manual/exercise interventions.
Prospective systematically allocated (quasi-randomized) trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing chiropractic manipulation + exercise vs mobilization + exercise.
Randomized controlled trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques; outcomes include ROM and disability (SRQ/SDQ).
Single-blind randomized pilot in shoulder capsulitis receiving steroid injection and home program ± added passive mobilization; outcomes pain (VAS), SPADI, and active ROM.
